account: PositiveWallaby1820 19 menit lalu
tweet: Yes siblings can be adopted separately but if at all possible they should be kept together and agencies should be doing everything they can to place siblings together first. Obviously that doesn’t always work out but if it doesn’t then maintaining that sibling bond should be a priority. Our daughter has two older brothers we try to keep in contact with but we were unable to handle all 3 of their needs together. They’ve never all lived together and the boys are in a long term stable placement who wouldn’t agree to take our daughter. I have so much guilt over not being able to care for all 3, but it does no good to put kids in a situation you already know won’t work (they all have multiple diagnosis, therapies, and needs and I work full-time, am in grad school, and my husband is away for the military often). You could always ask for an exception to your license to keep siblings together. That’s common especially in large sibling groups you just have to be weary of age/gender and room sharing rules.
